findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employees was observed bare-handling a waffle ice cream cone while inspector was present. The waffle cone ice cream was discarded. And education was provided. Ensure that employees are knowledgeable to avoid contaminating ready eat food items with their bare hands.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: An employee hand-bag was observed on the condiments’ counter in the chill area by the ice cream machine. Education was provided. The bag was removed and the surface was cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that employees are aware to put their personal belongings in the designated areas provided at all times.
findings.citation_text: 6-305.11 Designation. (A) Dressing rooms or dressing areas shall be designated if EMPLOYEES routinely change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be provided for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEES' clothing and other possessions.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: An accumulation of food debris was observed in the handwashing sink next to the grill in the kitchen. Education was provided. Ensure that all handwashing sinks within the facility are used only for the sole purpose of handwashing at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The concentration of the sanitizer in the sanitizer buckets was reading between 100-0 ppm. Discussed with the PIC. The buckets were remade. Ensure that the concentration of all sanitizers are measured within the appropriate range.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: An accumulation of soil was observed on the nozzles of the soda machine in the lobby area. The PIC was made aware. The nozzles were removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ones mentioned are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.comment: Inspector observed employee storing wet wiping cloth on a counter surface without it being held in a sanitizer solution. Education was provided and the behavior was abolished. Ensure that wet wiping cloths in-use are kept within a sanitizer solution at all times.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a plumbing leak in the lines beneath the three compartment sink in the chill area by the ice cream machines. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the necessary repairs are done according to the LAW.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Multiple mop heads were observed not stored properly. Discussed with PIC. The mop heads were removed to be stored properly. Ensure that the mop heads are always stored in a position that allows them to air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: An accumulation of ice and frost was observed on the fan hood of the standing freezer by the first drive-thru window. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspector that the ice will be cleaned. Ensure that the ice is cleaned providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrie to shut the faucet after washing their hands. PIC was made aware of the observed behavior. The appropriate correction was made. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable on proper handwashing etiquette.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed staff donning gloves without washing their hands. Discussed with PIC and the behavior as corrected.
Ensure that staff area knowledgeable about washing their hands before donning gloves at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(B) Cleaning Procedure. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use the following cleaning procedure in the order stated to clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms, including surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms: (1) Rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) Apply an amount of cleaning compound recommended by the cleaning compound manufacturer; (3) Rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds while: (a) Paying particular attention to removing soil from underneath the fingernails during the cleaning procedure, and (b) Creating friction on the surfaces of the hands and arms or surrogate prosthetic devices for hands and arms, finger tips, and areas between the fingers; (4) Thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) Immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying using a method as specified under § 6-301.12.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed staff failure to use a barrie to shut the faucet after washing their hands. PIC was made aware of the observed behavior and the appropriate correction was made. Ensure that staff are knowledgeable on proper handwashing etiquette.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observe a few live flies in the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensure inspector that the adequate actions will be taken. Ensure that the facility is free of insects or other pest to eliminate harborage.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.

Discussed with PIC and PIC told inspector that they had previously put in for the repairs of  the Ice machine in question. However, they were told by management that they will get a new one soon. Ensure that this equipment is remove from the facility if it is not being used or if there are no plans in motion to get it repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: There is observed an ice cream cake in the cake prep freezer that was uncovered directly under the fan unit that has ice accumulation. This ice accumulation had caused contamination on the cake that was uncovered. PIC discarded the cake during the inspection. Ensure that food items are protected form contamination during storage, preparation, and display. 
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: At the start of the inspection, there was no santiizer bucket available for use. PIC corrected this violation by utilizing the automatic dispenser available and making a sanitizer bucket for use. Ensure that a sanitizer bucket is readily available during all hours of operation. 
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: The single sink to the left of the back room triple sink is observed a sink faucet that has become detached from the sink structure. When tuned on, the faucet is able to fall off while in use. Ensure this faucet is repaired and maintained in good repair. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The following areas are observed to be in need of fresh caulking:
-The triple sink in the back
-Both hand sinks
-The triple sink near the cake decorating
Ensure these surfaces receive caulking to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface that eliminates the gap between the equipment and the wall. This is a repeat violation from the original inspection that took place on 6/21/2023 and the facility will receive a Warning Notice to document the violations.

(B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

Ensure these surfaces become part of the routine cleaning procedures to maintain the physical facilities clean.

(E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: Multiple employees were observed switching tasks without washing their hands before engaging in food preparation activities. Employees were educated on the spot and were asked to wash their hands with proper technique. Ensure that all staff are retrained on hand washing to allow contamination to be prevented from handling of food items. 
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment:
3-301.11: An employee was observed handling toast with their bare hands and placing it into the holding container. This employee was educated as to why this is an unacceptable practice and then instructed to wash their hands and utilize gloves when handling RTE foods. Ensure training is provided to all staff members on why bare hand contact is unacceptable and how to properly handle the food items. 
3-301.11: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall properly wash hands (C). (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall not contact RTE FOODS with bare hands – except washing fruits and veggies (P). (C) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall minimize contact with FOOD that is not RTE (Pf). (D) Contact does not apply to RTE Food being added as ingredient to be cooked. (E) FOOD EMPLOYEES not serving a HSP may contact exposed, RTE with bare hands if approved.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: It was observed an employee utilizing the hand sink by the ice cream line as a dump sink for the sanitizer bucket. This employee was educated as to why this is unacceptable due to the only purpose of this sink being hand washing. Employee then promptly continued dumping the bucket in the triple sink. Ensure all employees are aware that the hand washing sinks are only used for hand washing.
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: There were observed three cans of white queso sauce in the dry storage that were observed to be severely dented. These cans were shown to the PIC and pulled from service to be returned to the company or discarded. Ensure when deliveries are received that the food products are observed to be in good condition before accepting them and using them for food service.
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

(B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.comment:
6-303.11: The walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer both have a lightbulb that appears to be burnt out or not turned on. Ensure these bulbs are in working order and kept on during hours of operation. Or, if they are burnt out, they need to be replaced.
6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: Observed no Sanitizer Bucket present at the time of inspection. This was corrected on site by an employee who made up a bucket where the sanitizer concentration was 200ppm. Ensure that a sanitizer bucket is available at all times during the hours of operation.
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed the mixer in the ice cream station to be soiled with visible food residue. This was cleaned and sanitized during the inspection to correct the violation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Food contact surface is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment: Wet wiping cloths observed stored on prep surfaces and not in sanitizer solution. Store wiping cloths in sanitizer solution in between use.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animal foods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment: Ice scoop observed stored with the handle in contact with the ice in the ice bin. Store scoops with the handle extended up and out of the food. Scoop was adjusted and ice in contact was scooped out.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12  (C) In-Use Utensils are stored incorrectly. Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F. Reference 3-304.12.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Cake freezer observed with a significant amount of ice accumulation within. Defrost cake freezer. PIC reports that new seals are on order.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Mixer for blizzards observed soiled. Mixers must be washed, rinsed and sanitize at least every 4 hours in use.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Food contact surface is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment: Ice cream machine on the right is observed to be holding ice cream mix in the bottom of this unit at 67F as probed with a digital thermometer. Machine will be taken out of commission unit unit can be repaired and is holding mix at 41F or below at all times. Bormida will be called to repair unit. Unit was in the process of being emptied during the visit. Will spot check and conduct routine inspection next week.  (Bormida arrived as inspector was leaving).
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B)  (P) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food is not maintained at 41°F, or less. Reviewed cold holding requirements and discussed HACCP concept with employee and person in charge. Inadequately held food was discarded. Reference 3-501.16(A)(2) and (B).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: Drip pan in the ice cream machine on the right (the one not operating properly) does not have the drip pan in place and has dripped dirty water into the bin holding the bag of chocolate ice cream mix. Repair as needed to prevent this potential for contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11  (C) Food is not protected from contamination. Food shall be protected from contamination. Reference 3-307.11.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment: Leak observed at the knee pedals on the hand sink off the cook line. Repair plumbing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15  (C) The plumbing needs repair. Repair according to Illinois and local plumbing code.  Reference 5-205.15.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed no thermometer in prep cooler storing milk and juice. Provide thermometer in cooler.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed a carton of eggs stored of butterfingers in the walk in cooler. Manager stored eggs below read to eat food to CORRECT the violation.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed food debris at the top of the microwave stored in the back room. Wash, rinse, and sanitize microwave.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non food contact surfaces were soiled: 1) gaskets on both ice cream machines 2)unit to the left of the fryers with grease build up 3)lids stored on wire shelves in back room next to 3 compartment sink with food debris. Clean all non food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed walk in cooler floors with debris. Clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
REPEAT-Observed both hand sinks to be separating from the wall. Recaulk hand sinks.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
REPEATX2-Three wet mops were stored in used mop water. Hang mops to dry or invert mops.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There were no thermometers in the following coolers:  (A) 4 drawer freezer, and (B) topping cooler in chill area.  Thermometers were put in both coolers to CORRECT the violation.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
The solution in the red sanitizer bucket behind the front counter was 0 ppm quaternary ammonia.  It was changed out with fresh 400 ppm solution to CORRECT the violation.

750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
There was dried food on the can opener blade.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean and sanitize the blade on a daily basis or every 4 hours if used throughout the day.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
  (A) back (wall side) of fryer splash shields attached to the back of the fryers.
  (B) inside of topping cooler under the hot fudge dispenser.
  (C) door seals on the topping freezer to the left of the chill area 3-pan sink.
Clean these surfaces.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Food handling utensils and pan lids are stored uncovered on the wire rack opposite the 3-pan sink in the back of the store.  Place the utensils and lids in covered containers or put a plastic liner on the shelf above the equipment.

750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
(A)  Food baskets were stored food side up in the cooking area.  They were inverted to correct the violation.
(B)  Cup lids and cups were stored food side up in the vicinity of the drive up window in use.  Invert the lids and cups.

750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
The lids on the dumpsters were open upon arrival.  Close the lids.

750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(A)  The floor under the soda dispenser  by the drive up window was soiled.  Clean the floor.
(B)  The floor under the rack on the wall opposite the walk-in cooler door in the dry goods storage room was soiled.  Clean the floor.
(C)  There was no drain cover on the floor drain under the customer area soda dispenser (inside the cabinet) and there was mold in the drain (REPEAT VIOLATION).   Put a cover or grate over the drain and clean the drain.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A)  The wall under the 3-pan sink in the back of the store was soiled.  Clean the wall.
(B)  The wall to sink joint on the 3-pan sink in the back of the store has mold in it and a small gap in the caulk.  Clean out the old caulk and re-seal the gap.
(C)   The handsink in the chill area had a gap between the sink and wall.  Seal the gap.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Two bulbs were burnt out in the hood over the fryers.  Replace the bulbs.

750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 20 foot-candles of light on all food preparation surfaces and at equipment or utensil washing areas.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Cloths were laying the soda boxes stored on the rack to the left of the 3-pan sink in the back of the store.   Remove the cloths and store them away from food, drinks, utensils, food equipment, etc.

750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Three wet mops were stored in mop buckets.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)   Store mops with the heads up so they will air dry.

750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
